jcr:title: Salvation Fusion Bolts and Beams
thumbnailAltText: Salvation Fusion Bolts and Beams Stryker - Wright Medical Group
jcr:description: Salvation Fusion Bolts and Beams - Wright Medical Group Stryker - Indicated for fracture fixation, osteotomies, reconstruction procedures, non-unions, and fusions of bones in the foot and ankle including the Metatarsals, Cuneiforms, Cuboid, Navicular, Calcaneus and Talus. Specific examples include Medial Column Fusion and Lateral Column Fusion resulting from neuropathic osteoarthropathy (Charcot).

text_copy_copy.text: CONTACT US

text_copy_copy_copy.text: SPECIFICATION OVERVIEW

text.text: Indicated for fracture fixation, osteotomies, reconstruction procedures, non-unions, and fusions of bones in the foot and ankle including the Metatarsals, Cuneiforms, Cuboid, Navicular, Calcaneus and Talus. Specific examples include Medial Column Fusion and Lateral Column Fusion resulting from neuropathic osteoarthropathy (Charcot).

text_copy.text: Designed to address the demands of midfoot reconstruction

text.text: The system focuses on treating cases such as neuropathic deformity requiring arthrodesis of the medial and lateral columns, with or without corrective osteotomies.

Implant options

Designed to address surgical preference

 

Multiple diameter offerings
Allow for beaming of greater and lesser metatarsals

Easy to use
System designed with easy to use instrumentation that assists in attaining reproducible results

text_1915296274_copy_1506257410.text: The Salvation Fusion Bolts and Beams System should be used in the intramedullary canal in conjunction with external fixation, additional beams, plates, or contact casting until bony fusion has occurred.

text_1915296274_copy.text:
7.0mm fusion beam partially threaded

  • Lengths: 50mm to 160mm by 5mm increments
  • Thread length, proximal end: 11mm
  • Thread length, distal end: 34mm

7.0mm fusion beam fully threaded

  • Lengths: 50mm to 160mm by 5mm increments
  • Thread length, proximal end: 11mm

text_1915296274.text:
5.0 fusion bolt

  • Lengths: 60mm to 160mm by 5mm increments   
  • Thread length, proximal end: 10mm   
  • Thread length, distal end: 22mm

text_1915296274_copy.text:
6.5mm fusion bolt

  • Lengths: 80mm to 160mm by 5mm increments   
  • Thread length, proximal end: 10mm   
  • Thread length, distal end: 24mm

text.text:
Designed for strength

Made with Type II Anodized Titanium Alloy with demonstrated higher fatigue strength than other materials1
